title: Restricting a pushed-forward constant sheaf from one closed subset to another
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $Z,Z'\subseteq X$ closed subsets with inclusions $i:Z\to X$, $i':Z'\to X$, and $S$ a set. Let $\mathcal G=i'_*\underline S_{Z'}$ be the sheaf of sets on $X$ with $\mathcal G(V)=\{$locally constant maps $V\cap Z'\to S\}$ for $V\subseteq X$ open (restriction of maps as restriction), so $\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)$ is the set $\mathrm{LC}(Z',S)$ of locally constant maps $Z'\to S$. Let $\mathcal G|_Z=i^{-1}\mathcal G$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] $\theta:i_p\mathcal G\to\mathcal G|_Z$ of $i_p\mathcal G:U\mapsto\varinjlim_{V\supseteq U}\mathcal G(V)$ (colimit of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], coprojections $\iota^U_V$), as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3) with values in sets. Then there is a bijection $\beta:\Gamma(Z,\mathcal G|_Z)\to\mathrm{LC}(Z\cap Z',S)$ such that $\beta(\theta_Z(\iota^Z_X(g)))=g|_{Z\cap Z'}$ for every $g\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)=\mathrm{LC}(Z',S)$. (For $Z'=X$: $\Gamma(Z,\underline S_X|_Z)\cong\mathrm{LC}(Z,S)$ compatibly with restriction of locally constant maps.)

proof.text: Apply the existing inverse-image closed-pushforward theorem to the inclusion i:Z→X and the closed subset Z' of X. It supplies the sheaves of locally constant functions G and Q, a comparison b from the sheaf pullback to Q, bijective on every open, and its prescribed unit compatibility. The named section presheaf is definitionally the inline presheaf of the statement.

Use Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackIso to identify the sheaf pullback with the explicit sheafification of the presheaf pullback. Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies the corresponding units. On the top open, compose the inverse comparison component, b, and the explicit locally constant comap equivalence between the nested subtype on Z and the intersection subtype on X. Cancel the comparison isomorphism, reduce the identity P.map, and apply the two unit formulas to establish the displayed compatibility pointwise.
